titulo: What If You Could See Who Has a Crush on You?
premisa: You wake up and see a glowing pink number above every head, the number of people who have a crush on that person. Thin pink threads connect each admirer to their crush, and only you can see them. Scene by scene the consequences escalate. HIGH SCHOOL: the most popular guy in your class has a 0, and the quiet kid who sits alone has 7. Your crush's thread doesn't point at you. It points at your lab partner. WORK: your boss has a thread to the new intern, you warn HR, you get promoted, and suddenly everyone wonders how you 'always know'. FRIENDS: your best friend is about to get engaged, and the thread from her boyfriend goes to someone else. You tell her, and you lose a friend for saying the truth. SOCIETY: you launch a matchmaking app that 'guesses' who likes you with 100% accuracy. Dating apps crash, the app makes millions of dollars, and the news calls you 'the Love Oracle'. One detail always bugs you: in the mirror there's no number above your own head. FINAL: on a late-night subway a stranger stares at the empty space above you and whispers, 'You see them too, don't you?' Then he adds, 'Yours says 1. And the thread goes to me.'
gancho: What if a pink number above everyone's head showed how many people have a crush on them, and only YOU could see it?
